name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.
texts: Whenever the box falls, the agent must be holding the box on the very next step (i.e., pick it up immediately).
If the agent reaches the exit, it must be holding the box at that moment.
